title: refactor(examples): clean up, relay handling, add docs
body:

- Add RelayBanners component to warn about missing NIP-65 (10002) and key package relay list (10051)
- Add NIP-65 relay list editor in settings with read/write relay management
- Update examples to require explicit relay configuration before publishing
- Improve group subscription reconciliation to trigger on store changes
- Add triggerGroupStoreRefresh() for manual refresh when needed
- Fix last_resort key package handling to retain local private material per MIP-00
- Add getKeyPackageRefFromKeyPackageEvent() and include keyPackageEvent in welcome rumors

BREAKING CHANGE: Removed extraRelays$ from settings. Relay behavior is now driven by explicit NIP-65 (10002) and key package relay list (10051) configuration.

title: Add InviteReader class to client folder for easier gift wrap management

I intentionally removed the auto decryption functionality in the PR because my npub has 200+ gift wraps and would crash the app as soon as I opened it.
